question: Auscultation should be performed before palpation and percussion during a clinical examination of the abdomen, because mechanical stimulation of the bowel may artificially alter bowel sounds.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct to mark false. The standard surgical abdominal examination sequence is: Inspect → Palpate → Percuss → Auscultate. Auscultation comes last, not before palpation.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Wait — the conventional surgical sequence is Inspect → Palpate → Percuss → Auscultate. Auscultation last is the accepted clinical standard in general surgery (unlike in standard medical examination where auscultation precedes palpation).
